svg.title: TENG — James Vincent Calunsag / Computer engineer
svg.desc: A custom TENG wordmark on architectural construction lines, with four translucent forest green resin keycaps bearing ivory T, E, N, and G letters in a 2 by 2 arrangement. Warm paper with muted brass accents. James Vincent Calunsag. Computer engineer focused on software, frontend, and visual design. Open to opportunities. Dapitan, Philippines.
